source: https://www.als.org/local-support/certified-centers-clinics (paginated ?page=0-12; pages 6, 8, 10 and 12 would not load, so those entries were taken from the same listing's full-text state view, e.g. https://www.als.org/support/certified-centers-clinics?search_api_fulltext=Ohio, which shows the same type labels). Designations cross-checked against the state-filtered views and individual als.org detail pages.
missing_states_or_notes: All 242 entries on the als.org listing were accounted for (20 per page x 12 pages + 2). Only entries tagged 'Certified Treatment Center of Excellence' (alsa-coe) or 'Recognized Treatment Center' (alsa-rtc) are included; 'Affiliated Clinic'-only entries and VA clinics without a designation are excluded. VA medical centers that carry a CoE/RTC designation are included and flagged in notes. The als.org listing has no entries for AK, DE, HI (affiliated only), ID (affiliated only), AR (affiliated only), MS (affiliated only), MT (affiliated only), NV (affiliated only), ND (affiliated only), OK (affiliated only), RI (affiliated only), WY (none) or any US territory. Synapticure is listed by als.org as a 'Nationwide Telemedicine Provider' (phone 855-255-5917, https://www.synapticure.com/) and is not included as an item. The ALS Association announced its 100th Certified Treatment Center of Excellence (UCLA) in Sept. 2025, consistent with the count here. Counts: 104 alsa-coe, 24 alsa-rtc. States covered: AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV.
